newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Soc Dems see '97 budget passing in December.
newsitem.headline: Czech Soc Dems see '97 budget passing in December.

text.p: The parliamentary leader of the Czech Social Democrats Stanislav Gross said on Tuesday he expected parliament to approve the 1997 budget in December even though his party is seeking changes to the government's draft.

"I expect that this year it will also be passed in December as in past years," Gross told reporters. Referring to changes the Social Democrats want to the government draft, he said: "This is not the same as we would want to reject the budget."
The lower chamber of parliament is due to hold the first reading of the budget later on Tuesday.
Earlier Gross said the Social Democrats would seek changes to two paragraphs in the draft budget.
